text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...♪
It's such a wonderful place, Papa! Mama!

text_block_list.name: Loves's Father
text_block_list.text:
That's right! This campsite is a real hidden gem.
It's the perfect spot to get away from the hustle and bustle of the city and relax.

text_block_list.name: Loves's Father
text_block_list.text:
I heard it coincided with our day off at camp.
I wanted to give you a chance to unwind somewhere
relaxing, so I arranged it right away.

text_block_list.name: Loves's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
I'm so glad you could make it too, Trainer♪
choice_data_list: (To think things would turn out like this...)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer-kun.
The day after tomorrow is an all-out rest day, right?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer-chan.
The day after tomorrow is an all-out rest day, right?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
My mom and dad are on a trip and messaged me,
"We're staying nearby, so do you wanna meet up if you have the day off?"
...they said.
choice_data_list: Sounds great, why don't you go?
Sounds great, go for it!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
And also...
"We'd love it if your Trainer joined us too,"
...they said.

text_block_list.name: Loves's Father
text_block_list.text: If you're up for it today, please tell me all about the outlook for Loves' running and more, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Understood, absolutely.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, look at all this outdoor gear!
You've really put together a serious collection!

text_block_list.name: Loves's Mother
text_block_list.text: Fufu. The house is already full of gear. She's been saying things like, "I want to go camping with Loves someday"... It's been her dream recently.

text_block_list.name: Loves's Father
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, so the real fun starts now!
We're gonna light the fire
and have a barbecue!

text_block_list.name: Loves's Father
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's get started right away! Which would you prefer:
lighting a fire without fire starters, or fishing?
I'll take whichever one you don't choose.
choice_data_list: It's way more authentic than I expected...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Dad really gets obsessed with things.
So, which shall it be?
Starting a fire without fire starters, or fishing in a mountain stream?
choice_data_list: Probably the fire-starting part — that's the heavy lifting
It's a test of patience... this fishing, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
We've gathered the big firewood, right?
For the rest, dry twigs and dry pinecones are fine, yes?
choice_data_list: Apparently it can be used as kindling instead

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Huh, how interesting. ...Wait?
If you need dry pinecones,
wouldn't the twigs need to be dry too?
choice_data_list: True. Ah... this twig is a bit damp.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Let's divide the work and pick out only the dry ones.
I'll gather them all up, so could you do the sorting?
choice_data_list: Got it!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ei! Oh? It split at an angle.
Maybe chopping firewood is surprisingly tough?

text_block_list.name: Loves's Father
text_block_list.text:
Quite a haul, quite a haul~. Looks like dinner is secured.
...Oh, seems like you're having a tough time over here?
Need a hand?
choice_data_list: Thank you, but I'm alright!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's right. We'll be fine.
No matter how difficult things get, we've always brainstormed and worked through them together.

text_block_list.name: Loves's Father
text_block_list.text:
Nice, thinking things through and trying
your best even when you don't know is key.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Alright then.
Time to pick up the pace a bit!
choice_data_list: Dividing the tasks here seems like the right move.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Divide up the chores by chopping firewood?
choice_data_list: I'll just hammer in the tip of the hatchet blade and pass it along, so let's do it assembly-line style.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Ah... I see. Since our downward swings didn't sync up, we're dividing the labor. So all I have to do is keep cracking them open!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Alright, here I go~...
Love me♡ Say cheese!
choice_data_list: Huh!? L-love you!? ...What's this?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Huh? It's just a work chant.
It's way more fun if we keep a rhythm, right?
We still need to start the fire, so let's hurry up.

text_block_list.name: Loves's Father
text_block_list.text:
Well now, the fire's going perfectly!
Looks like we'll be able to cook without any trouble.
Plus, watching you do that was really impressive.

text_block_list.name: Loves's Father
text_block_list.text:
Trainer understood their strengths and weaknesses, dividing
the tasks effectively. Loves naturally managed to boost motivation
for the monotonous work.

text_block_list.name: Loves's Father
text_block_list.text: I had heard your coaching wasn't a one-way street... but respecting each other's ideas while staying in sync is truly a wonderful strength.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yes, aren't they?
That's why I'm able to do my best freely and comfortably.

text_block_list.name: Loves's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad you could sign with such a wonderful Trainer♪
With this, you're sure to be in good hands going forward♪

text_block_list.name: Loves's Father
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right.
With this, even if I'm flying all over the world,
I can cheer you on without any worries.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, thank you. ♡
Now then, the water's boiling, so let's have a tea break with Mama's coffee. ♪

text_block_list.name: Loves's Father
text_block_list.text: Well Loves, good luck with your upcoming races. And you too... Trainer.
choice_data_list: I'll do my best.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Drive safe!
...Fufu.
I'm glad you seemed to have a good time.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Trainer-kun. Thanks to you, I feel like I can really put my all into training again.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan, thanks.
Thanks to you, I feel like I can put even more
passion into my training.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Papa said that too, after all... Fufu. I look forward to working with you again♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: We really have to catch some fish...! Otherwise, it's going to be a pretty lonely barbecue without a main dish. Let's do our best!
choice_data_list: Got it!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun, just a little more!
choice_data_list: Aah! It got away again...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Trainer-chan, just a little further!
choice_data_list: Aah! It got away again...!

text_block_list.name: Loves's Father
text_block_list.text:
Oh, having a bit of a tough time?
Need some help?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...No, it's alright.
I'll do my best and catch one somehow!

text_block_list.name: Loves's Father
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, sounds good. Just one thing, though.
River fish are easily startled, so rather than both of us fishing,
maybe it'd be better if you held the landing net, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: A landing net...? You mean that little net?
choice_data_list: So one person needs to be on support duty, right?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Well, true, both of them have barely managed to get away each time so far.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
All right, right around there... and... drop.
Being patient until you get a bite is the key.
Let's not rush and wait for our chance to strike, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Kh!
It's here!
It's pretty big!
choice_data_list: Don't rush! Let's take it slow and steady!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: (That's right. I rushed in alone trying to reel it in and messed up, but Trainer-kun will definitely seal the deal in the end.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: (That's right. I rushed in alone trying to reel it in and messed up, but Trainer-chan will definitely seal the deal in the end.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Slowly.
......Reel it in slowly.
............Trainer-kun!
choice_data_list: Now's the time...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Slowly.
......Reel it in slowly.
............Trainer-chan!
choice_data_list: Now's the time...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Here you go, Trainer-kun.
I've handled my side.
choice_data_list: Okay! Let's get skewering!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Here you go, Trainer-chan.
I've handled my side.
choice_data_list: Okay! Let's get skewering!

text_block_list.name: Loves's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Loves.
Do you have the fish for this dish yet?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm fine, Mama.
Now as for Trainer-kun—
choice_data_list: I've got the shiso miso all ready too!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm fine, Mama.
Now as for Trainer-chan—
choice_data_list: I've got the shiso miso all ready too!

text_block_list.name: Loves's Mother
text_block_list.text:
The two of them are in total sync.
They know exactly what the other is trying to do, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Loves's Father
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, communication is important.
With this, the future's looking bright.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, Papa, really.
Hehe."

text_block_list.name: Loves's Mother
text_block_list.text: Shall I make some soup with the leftover ingredients then?♪ Loves, give me a hand once you're done with that♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Yeees♪

text_block_list.name: Loves's Father
text_block_list.text:
"If you ever have the chance, please join us, Trainer!
When that time comes, let's talk about an even further matured Loves!
Well then, until next time!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe, and away they go.
choice_data_list: Your parents sound like a lot of fun, huh?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yes, truly.
Thanks to that, I feel energized.
I can work even harder starting tomorrow♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Now then, before autumn arrives, we've got to
push through this summer and get stronger♪
